# Outcrop Inc

Outcrop Inc builds focused, open-source applications for macOS and iPhone.
The company is registered in Washington State, United States.

## Applications

- [CropPrint]({{siteUrl}}/apps/cropprint/): Crop photos without distortion for printing, passports, social media, and screen backgrounds. Create print sheets and add text or frames.

## Privacy

Outcrop applications process user content on the device and do not contain analytics, advertising, or telemetry.
The Outcrop website uses Google Analytics only for aggregate website metrics.
The website does not use analytics data for advertising or cross-site profiles.
